item.title: Meduza: The Telegraph identifies Russian biker Oleg Levushkin as suspected organizer of Leipzig airport sabotage. It links the operation to a GRU unit whose officers are accused in the Skripal poisoning.
item.description: The British newspaper The Telegraph has identified the suspected organizer of a sabotage attack at Leipzig Airport. German media had previously reported on the suspect, citing German law enforcement authorities, without naming him.

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): G7 countries agree not to restrict energy exports
item.description: The decision comes amid a sharp rise in prices and high volatility in oil markets

item.title: Meduza: The U.S. seized $5.4 million from ‘Orthodox oligarch’ Konstantin Malofeyev and sent it to support Ukrainian veterans. Russia has now opened a criminal case over the confiscation.
item.description: Russia’s Investigative Committee, the country’s main federal investigative agency, said it has opened a criminal case over U.S. authorities’ “misappropriation” of funds belonging to Russian businessman Konstantin Malofeyev, founder of the Tsargrad channel. The “Orthodox oligarch” himself filed the complaint seeking an investigation.

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Covert strike behind enemy lines with underground routes practiced at Center-2026 drills
item.description: The assault groups carried out a covert advance along the water supply line and through a pre-prepared underground passage to the rear of the enemy’s stronghold, the Russian Defense Ministry reported

item.title: Meduza: Hospital in Russia’s Irkutsk region quarantined amid reports that a patient died of pneumonic plague
item.description: The inpatient department at a district hospital in Shelekhov, in Russia’s Irkutsk region, has been closed because one of its patients is suspected of having a “particularly dangerous infection.”

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Putin observes Center-2026 exercises
item.description: The exercises are aimed at improving the practical skills of the command staff and headquarters of the formations in managing troop groupings

item.title: Meduza: A Ukrainian grandmother came to Kazakhstan to collect her grandson. Instead, she was detained at Russia’s request.
item.description: Ukrainian citizen Liubov Rozhanska was detained at Astana’s airport after arriving from Istanbul. She is now being held in a pretrial detention center, and a court hearing is expected within three days. Russia requested her detention through the Collective Security Treaty Organization, her lawyers told DW. Rozhanska could be extradited to Russia, where she is being investigated for child abduction.

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Latest ground-based complex with LMUR missiles deployed during Center-2026 drills
item.description: The Russian Defense Ministry said that the ground-based missile system is designed for high-precision destruction of important stationary and moving targets at a range of up to 20 kilometers

item.title: Meduza: Russian ‘anti-feminist’ blogger Alexey Podnebesny is sentenced to three years for indecent acts with a 15-year-old girl
item.description: A St. Petersburg court sentenced blogger Alexey Podnebesny to three years in a penal colony for indecent acts involving a minor, Mediazona reported.

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Center-2026 drills conducted in accordance with Russian military training plan — Putin
item.description: The Russian president noted that the drills are linked to the Interaction-2026 command-and-staff exercise, which is taking place within the framework of the Collective Security Treaty Organization

item.title: Meduza: Zelensky says Putin ordered Russia’s military chiefs to abandon rules of war in airstrikes on Ukraine
item.description: Vladimir Putin ordered his military commanders to abandon the rules of war in airstrikes on Ukraine, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky told the Financial Times in an interview. Ukrainian intelligence agencies obtained the information through intercepts, he said.

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Troop strength at Center-2026 exercises totals 6,000 men — Russian defense minister
item.description: Representatives from nearly 60 countries, along with forces and equipment from the CSTO collective security system, are taking part in the exercises

item.title: The Moscow Times: Ex-Deputy Governor Who Planned to Fight in Ukraine Gets 14 Years for Military Supplies Theft
item.description: Alexander Vlasov, who also headed the Kuban Cossack Host, was arrested one day after he resigned in order to fight in Ukraine.

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Putin meets with foreign military attaches
item.description: The Russian president visited the Chebarkul training ground in the Chelyabinsk Region, where he observed a phase of the Center-2026 strategic command-and-staff exercises

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Special military op’s experience used during Center-2026 drills — Putin
item.description: The Russian president said that new weapons and vehicles are used during the drills

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): G7 to release 100 mln barrels of diesel, other reserves
item.description: G7 countries also agreed to coordinate maintenance schedules across refineries to prevent simultaneous capacity shutdowns and temporarily increase utilization rates where feasible

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Iskander-M, Tornado-S crews launch coordinated missile strike against 'enemy'
item.description: Orlan-30 drone crews provided target reconnaissance and strike adjustments, the Russian Defense Ministry reported

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Flydubai suspends flights to Tel Aviv at authorities’ request — CEO
item.description: Ghaith Al Ghaith confirmed that all 172 passengers and crew members aboard flight FZ 1073, which was flying from Dubai to Tel Aviv on September 30, are safe

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Kiev begins to close all bridges during air raid alerts — media report
item.description: Footage published by the outlet shows long traffic jams already forming on the bridges

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Trans-Caspian Corridor sea freight exceeds 4.5 mln metric tons in seven months
item.description: According to Bakytzhan Sagintayev, the heads of government discussed the development of transport infrastructure along the east-west and north-south routes, including in conjunction with China’s Belt and Road Initiative

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Damage to refineries decreasing — Novak
item.description: The government promptly took a wide range of measures to saturate the domestic market with fuel, the Russian deputy prime minister added
